summary: Replaces the buggy hand-rolled trim_docstring with stdlib inspect.cleandoc, which correctly handles non-empty first lines per PEP 257; this is the correct, minimal fix and matches Django's actual accepted patch. No correctness or regression problems block merge.

issues.description: Removes the trim_docstring helper from django.contrib.admindocs.utils. It is an undocumented internal utility, but third-party code importing it would break; acceptable for an internal admindocs helper but worth noting.
views.py already does 'import inspect', so the added 'from inspect import cleandoc' is redundant; could call inspect.cleandoc() instead of adding a second import. Pure style nit.
cleandoc does not per-line rstrip trailing whitespace as the old trim_docstring did; a negligible cosmetic difference for rST rendering, no functional impact.
